text:
jamie: Heads-up — swapping the order: Roadmap first, then Q&A. Need AV confirmation. Mic check now? :wave:

devon: On it. Seeing encoder CPU spike on prod-node-2. If it keeps up we'll failover to RTMP fallback and local recorder B.

maria: Captions are ~6-8s behind on preview. Can we enable Zoom auto-transcribe as backup?

devon: yes, enabling fallback. Doing OBS service restart on capture host.

devon: ```sh
sudo systemctl restart obs-capture.service
# if fails: /opt/recorder/bin/reroute-rtmp --to rtmp://backup.redwood.tv/ingest
```

recording-bot: Recording started on local-recorder-B (rec-42). Stream status: DEGRADED -> FALLBACK

alex: For Q&A order — can we ask people to drop live questions in #all-hands-qa and prioritize product/team tickets first?

jamie: Yep. Qs submitted via thread or use: https://forms.redwood.com/allhands-quick-qa

sunita: I'll monitor captions and manually pull transcript snippets if needed. Will flag missed bits for clips team.

maria: Also mic 3 is peaking a bit — devon can you lower gain on line-in3?

devon: lowered gain -6dB. Watching levels.

recording-bot: Stream switched to RTMP fallback. Live viewers: 982 -> 718. Local recording OK.

jamie: Leadership/product leads please be ready for the roadmap slot at T+5. Slides are on Drive and queued for presenter.

alex: Slides queued and speaker notes updated.

maria: Caption lag improved to ~2s after switching. Good to go.

jamie: Thanks everyone. If anything else, tag me. After show we'll post clips + full transcript within 24h. :thumbsup:
